name: httpx
description: HTTPX raises DecodingError for an empty response body carrying Content-Encoding: zstd, including the bodyless HEAD responses reported in issue #3411. Upstream PR #3412 fixed this non-security content-decoding defect on 2024-11-22 and added regression tests for empty and truncated content.
question: HTTPX should accept an empty response body with Content-Encoding: zstd and expose empty content, while continuing to reject invalid or truncated compressed data and correctly decode nonempty responses. Preserve existing response and streaming behavior. Only edit httpx/_decoders.py; do not edit tests.

candidate_selection.basis: Small documented functional defect with genuine upstream regressions; reproduced entirely through in-process Response objects on Python 3.12.
candidate_selection.unused_check: Fetched all handoff origin branches; git log --all -- evals/historical/httpx is empty. Scoped evals history searches found no encode/httpx fixture, fix SHA, test_zstd_empty, or Zstandard data is incomplete. Numeric substring hits were unrelated Click timing values.
candidate_selection.patch_scope: Complete upstream tests/test_decoders.py diff; complete upstream httpx/_decoders.py diff. Unrelated release edits in README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and httpx/__version__.py are omitted.

suite.scope: Complete standard decoder and response-model modules, covering content decoding plus synchronous and asynchronous response consumption. HTTPX has a larger client/transport/network suite outside this functional area.
suite.configuration: Original pyproject.toml unchanged: -rxXs and all original warning filters, including error. No -k/-m filters, deselection, test rewrites, or plugin suppression.
suite.network: No external network is needed. Diagnostics and grading run under unshare -Urn; selected modules use in-process responses and both original anyio backends.

restrictions.source_only_oracle: Fresh parent plus genuine regression tests; copy only httpx/_decoders.py from the repaired archive.
restrictions.metadata: No build or installed HTTPX distribution metadata is required by these modules. Import the archived package directly through workspace-relative PYTHONPATH; do not install HTTPX.

dependency_provenance.selection: pytest, trio, cryptography, trustme, uvicorn and chardet match the upstream parent's requirements.txt pins. Runtime, decoder and transitive dependencies are compatible pinned releases available by the November 2024 fix. pip is a separately pinned setup tool. No package build is needed; wheels only, no dependency resolution, no editable install.
dependency_provenance.release_check: Queried https://pypi.org/pypi/{name}/{version}/json for every installed distribution and checked every release-file upload timestamp is earlier than 2026-09-14, seven days before validation.

commands.each_fresh_archive: mkdir "$WORKSPACE"; git -C "$UPSTREAM" archive "$BASE" | tar -x -C "$WORKSPACE"; git -C "$WORKSPACE" apply "$PACKAGE/regression.patch"
commands.diagnostic_and_verify: PYTHONPATH="$WORKSPACE" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_ADDOPTS='' NO_COLOR=1 unshare -Urn "$VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -vv tests/test_decoders.py tests/models/test_responses.py
commands.actual_harness_calls: The local validation driver imports cases, diagnostic, grade and testCounts from the unchanged evals/codex-historical-workloads.mjs. It assigns cases.httpx from this case.json in memory, sets JEV_HISTORICAL_CACHE, calls diagnostic('httpx', baseline), diagnostic('httpx', fixed), diagnostic('httpx', fixed, true), then grade('httpx', fixed) with recorded fixed_counts. No shared registration or harness file was edited; initialize() and all inference were not invoked.
commands.oracle: The actual grade() copies the broken baseline into a separate oracle workspace, restores baseline tests/configuration by construction, copies only editable httpx/_decoders.py, and calls diagnostic(..., true). The 125 original archive files were independently hash-checked after grading.
commands.cwd_and_network: Every pytest command executes from its own WORKSPACE with the declared environment plus the harness's PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTEST_ADDOPTS='', NO_COLOR=1. All diagnostics and grading, including fixed-workspace setup, ran inside the same unshare -Urn network namespace without external connectivity.
commands.syntax_json_type_checks: bash -n evals/historical/httpx/setup.sh; python3.12 -m json.tool evals/historical/httpx/case.json; npm run typecheck

setup_results.absent_venv: Succeeded: created Python 3.12 venv, installed pins, pip check passed, imported the broken archive.
setup_results.reuse_policy: An already initialized venv must exactly match the complete pinned distribution set. Reuse performs no pip install. A populated mismatching venv is rejected without changing its dependencies.

source_import_checks.assertions: Each path resolved exactly to its workspace file. HTTPX distribution metadata was absent from the venv; __version__ remained the unmodified parent's 0.27.2. setup.sh independently asserts both package and decoder imports.

known_gaps: Only Linux x86_64 with CPython 3.12.13 was validated.
Initial dependency installation requires package-index access; the same initialized venv is reused offline without dependency changes.
The full HTTPX client, transport, CLI, documentation and typing suites are outside the selected decoder/response functional scope; both complete relevant modules ran with zero exclusions or skips.
This package is intentionally not registered in the shared workload list. The parent session must integrate it separately before evaluation.
